description: This file contains test cases for the Solana NextJS template project, utilizing pytest for testing project initialization, configuration loading, template variable substitution, and post-processing scripts. It includes fixtures for creating temporary directories and mock template structures, and validates the correct behavior of project setup routines.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for test outputs and cleans it up after tests.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration files and template files, including hidden files for testing proper inclusion.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig instance representing a sample project configuration for testing.

methods.name: test_nextjs_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that the template's initial info retrieval provides expected configuration commands.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests the process of initializing a project from the template, including directory creation, content substitution, and inclusion of hidden files.

methods.name: test_parameter_defaults(template_dir, temp_dir)
methods.description: Ensures default parameters are correctly applied when none are provided.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that the post-processing script executes correctly and the completion indicator is created.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests loading project configuration from a JSON file.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Validates that template variables inside files are properly replaced with project parameters.
